verdict.rationale: Together AI is API-first: docs show programmatic access via API key/base URL, a server-side TypeScript/JavaScript SDK, async batch workloads, and a CLI (`tg`) for deploying endpoints and fine-tuning jobs, all of which support headless/CI automation without a UI. missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD pipeline example (e.g. GitHub Actions) or independent hands-on report of running it in an automated pipeline.
